register.name: Seznam osob (§ 14 zákona o obalech) / VISOH2
register.notes: Page fetched 2026-08-16 — confirms the Seznam osob under §14 of Packaging Act 477/2001 Sb. and that a joint-performance contract with the authorised packaging company (EKO-KOM) exempts from individual listing. Registration fee 800 CZK (~€33) and 60-day application deadline per earlier search-level research (not on the fetched page — reconfirm).

pro.membershipRequired: de-facto — EKO-KOM contract is the standard route and exempts from individual listing
pro.ecoModulation: Strong bottle eco-modulation: recycled-content clear PET beverage bottles 2,822 CZK/t (≈0.117 €/kg) vs virgin coloured-opaque 22,585 CZK/t (≈0.933 €/kg); composite plastics and 'others' 24,066 CZK/t (≈0.994 €/kg).

notes: Rates from the official EKO-KOM 'Price list valid from 1.1.2026' PDF (fetched 2026-08-16), one-way sales (household) packaging, converted from CZK/t at 24.22 CZK/EUR (ECB-derived rate, 2026-08-16): paper 7,152 CZK/t → 0.295; rigid plastics 15,839 → 0.654 (soft/flexible 15,546 → 0.642); glass 1,852 → 0.076; steel (Fe) 2,611 → 0.108 (shown as 'metal'; rigid aluminium 5,220 → 0.216, flexible Al 18,032 → 0.745); wood 3,754 → 0.155; beverage cartons 10,967 → 0.453 ('composite'). Annual contract fee 1,600 CZK/yr ≈ €66. Invoices issued in CZK only — EUR values are indicative conversions.
